english.title: Keeper / person in occupation of premises in Wales fail to arrange isolation of bovine animals
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the keeper of a bovine animal on]_
(B)_[the keeper of bovine animals on]_
(C)_[a person in occupation of]_

premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..)

(D)_[upon which a bovine animal was kept which a veterinary inspector was satisfied was an affected or suspected animal,]_
(E)_[upon which a veterinary inspector was satisfied that tuberculosis had been identified,]_
(F)_[when a veterinary inspector was satisfied that tuberculosis had been identified on premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF PREMISES..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to article 18(1)(e) of the Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010 and sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
